goal:
T52 — R1-R5 Replay page (v3.8 §3 signature UX; SNAP-02..05). Data comes from the T51 API (being built in
parallel): GET /v1/evolution/runs -> {runs: [...]}, GET /v1/evolution/runs/{id} -> {run_id, app_id, title, status,
manifest {app_id, rounds, cost_basis, runner_cost, disclosure, lanes}, rounds: [{index, name, goal, sides: {evoforge:
SNAP, single: SNAP}}], totals: {evoforge|single: {cost_cents, elapsed_ms, verified_rounds}}} where SNAP = {status:
READY|UNVERIFIED|FAILED|PENDING, verified, heldout {passed, n}, cost_cents, elapsed_ms, source_sha, preview_html?,
preview_error?, diff?, events?}. Build the web side only (no API changes):

1. apps/web/lib/roundReplay.ts — pure functions, no React, no fetch:
   - roundView(run, index) -> null if that round is absent, else {index, name, sides: {evoforge: V, single: V}} with
     V = {status, verified (true only for READY), score "passed/n" or "—", cost "N¢" or "—", previewHtml (that side's own
     preview_html for that round, or null when PENDING/absent; never another round's or the other side's)}.
   - latestCommonRound(run) -> highest round index where neither side is PENDING (0 if none).
   - firstLatest(run) -> [1, latestCommonRound(run)].
   - nextRound(i, run) -> i+1 if that round exists, else null (auto replay stops, no wraparound).
   - totalsView(run) -> {evoforge|single: {cost "N¢", verified "k/R" with R = manifest.rounds, elapsed}}.
2. apps/web/components/RoundReplay.tsx — client component taking {run}: R1..R5 scrubber (buttons, current highlighted,
   each showing both sides' status dot), First and Latest buttons, Play/Pause auto replay (setInterval stepping with
   nextRound; it only changes the selected round, it never fetches), two columns EvoForge | Single AI each with status
   badge (READY/UNVERIFIED/FAILED/PENDING with distinct colours), cumulative score, cost, SandboxedPreview of that side's
   previewHtml (fallback text when null), a totals strip and the manifest disclosure; a "Recorded run" label.
   No fetch( in this file. Mobile (<768px): stack the two columns.
3. apps/web/app/[locale]/replay/page.tsx — lists recent runs (listEvolutionRuns) and shows the selected one
   (getEvolutionRun) with RoundReplay; empty state when there are no runs; poll every 5 s only while the run status is
   "running".
4. apps/web/lib/api.ts — add the types and listEvolutionRuns() / getEvolutionRun(id) using API_BASE + /v1/evolution/runs.
5. Nav: add a Replay link (`${prefix}/replay`) in apps/web/app/[locale]/layout.tsx next to Arena.
6. i18n: "replay" namespace in apps/web/messages/en.json and ko.json with at least: title, first, latest, play, pause,
   recorded-run, pending, failed, unverified, ready, evoforge, single, empty, cost, score, totals.
Keep tsc green. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t52.py (may read the web files / run node like the sealed test).
